title: Panda Adventure HUD configuration
description: Authoritative config for the S6a HUD blockout (gADR-0000, gADR-0004): the value-change pulse tween and (since P2-S9, #445) the HUD font reference. The placement margin and the HUD font size live in scale_spec.json (gADR-0013) and are composed into the derived HudConfig by the builder. The HUD's CONTENT (live HP/MP/EXP/Gold + Current weapon) is fixed by the GDD's 'HUD & UI' section. Converted by scripts/build_config.py into the derived content/data/generated/hud_config.tres (HudConfig).

value_punch_scale.description: Scale punch applied to a HUD label the moment its value changes (the blockout 'juice' tween, recovering to 1.0); each component strictly positive.

value_tween_duration.description: Seconds for the value-change punch to recover to normal scale; strictly positive.

hud_font.description: Optional font asset reference for the HUD labels (P2-S9, #445): an Asset manifest id the builder resolves to the single-homed res:// path of a Godot Font (a bitmap .fnt derived by tools/assets/fonts.py, gADR-0014); absent (or empty) leaves the engine-default font. The HUD applies it via add_theme_font_override at the Scale spec's hud_font_size (gADR-0013). Asset references are data (gADR-0000).
